name: Italian Turkey Zucchini Noodle Casserole
note: Low-carb Italian ground-turkey + spiralized-zucchini + tomato + mozzarella bake (14g carbs). Catalog dedup confirmed: every Italian ground-turkey bake in the catalog is pasta/ricotta-based (ground-turkey-lasagna-casserole, baked-ziti-ground-turkey-ricotta, turkey-manicotti, turkey-bolognese/ragu-penne) - this swaps the starch to zucchini noodles, a distinct low-carb plate none of those fit. Cross-lane check vs accepted-slugs [creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet, chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake]: no twin. POOL/CROSS-PROTEIN WATCH: a beef or ground-chicken Italian zucchini-noodle tomato-mozzarella bake would be the same dinner under another protein - reject such a twin against this acceptance if it reaches me.
